independent_unit: one H; two methods are paired, not two independent histories

initialization_contract.basis: frozen parent evaluator and reused fit helper; optimizer is not rerun
initialization_contract.initial: same candidate H-fit R/X and historical states; future states from their own meters
initialization_contract.second_start: same seeded R/X perturbation and box clipping; corresponding future states may differ

replay_coverage: counts cover successfully audited histories; incomplete/error histories remain explicit and make success false

source_audit.interpretation: saved source bytes verified; current files may belong to a later version
